notes.title: Mahokenshi - Rebrand & 2023
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Samurai![/h3]

A huge thank you to all of you for making this year so unforgettable for Mahokenshi! Your passion and support have meant the world to us and made this period an unforgettable one. Here's to more adventures together in the coming year!

In the meantime, we do have a small visual update for you. This update is, quite literally, the name of the game.

[b]Reflecting on our Journey:[/b]
Developing and publishing Mahokenshi has been an epic journey, much like the heroic adventures you've encountered across the Celestial Islands. We aim to bring these adventures to as many players as possible.
[b]
A new direction:[/b]
It’s been almost a year since the release of Mahokenshi, and we've come to realize that we want the title of the game to better reflect the experiences within. We want people who stumble upon Mahokenshi for the first time while browsing Steam to instantly recognize and look forward to the card battling challenges that await.

So, without further ado, give a warm welcome to Mahokenshi: The Samurai Deckbuilder.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/ce624a37bae081fe6df151fc1ca3319b59bb1bdc.png[/img]

This subtitle is like a tagline—a cosmetic change for the store page and a clear representation of what new players can expect in the dynamic world we've built and continue to expand upon collectively (the team and I still get excited seeing all those community maps).

[b]Cheers to more adventures in 2024! 
[/b]On behalf of the entire Mahokenshi team, we extend our deepest thanks once more to each and every one of you. Your support has been the key to our motivation, and we're excited for what’s to come.

Here's to more adventures, challenges, and victories in 2024. So, unsheath your katanas, re-explore the Celestial Islands, build your deck, and fight off the relentless corruption.

Thank you for protecting the Celestial Islands!

The Mahokenshi Team

[b]Stay tuned for all the exciting news on Mahokenshi, and of course, join our community on Discord!
[/b]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/QrkCYccVkZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/57663fbcb3888c8fa1305f962073ed8e07587395.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Mahokenshi – Free DLC & Mission Editor now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Free DLC & Mission Editor
[/h1]

[h3]Hello Samurai!
[/h3]

We’re thrilled to inform you that our biggest update by far is now live, and 
available for download. 

As mentioned in our post last week – this update includes a free DLC ,“Mahokenshi -  The Designer’s Guide”, a mission editor, and much requested save states!

We look forward to seeing your creations uploaded in the workshop. We might 
even give the creators of the top 3 rated maps a special shoutout in our next 
post! 

[h3]Mid-Missions saving now available!
[/h3]
One of the most requested features since launch has been the ability to save at 
any point during a mission, to allow for as much flexibility as possible while 
gaming. We saw and we have delivered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/541ae176b5ab71f8aa4791c25bda98e19707b713.gif[/img]

[h3]Mission Editor
[/h3]
To give you, the community, replayability we decided to turn the map creation 
development tool into a feature. As mentioned in the previous news post, this 
feature will conveniently allow the ability to browse downloaded maps or create 
your own, allowing you to shape your own maps, one hex at a time! This can 
mean placing hordes of enemies, setting objectives, creating quests with 
rewards, and more. It’s an expansive tool directly derived from what the 
developers used to create the campaign.

To create community maps, simply boot up the game, go to ‘Custom Missions’, 
and select the Mission Editor. Done creating? Test it via the Play button, and if 
you’re satisfied, click the Publish to Steam button!

To play self-created or community created maps, go to the mission browser! Here
you can either edit existing maps or download new ones using the integrated ‘Browse Missions from the Community’ button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/778ce4ddaabc655d2c12b8179bc05bdefc5204e6.gif[/img]

[h3]Mahokenshi -  The Designer’s Guide
[/h3]
The Designer’s Guide brings 5 brand new carefully crafted maps to your 
attention, which help you to get some experience with the mission-editor, while 
serving as fun and challenging maps to beat. 

[b]Map 1: Defeat The Armored Oni 

Map 2: Run! 

Map 3: The Oni Archipelago

Map 4: Protect The Villages 

Map 5: Defend The Island [/b]

For further information on each map, check out the free DLC store page linked below! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399250/Mahokenshi__The_Designers_Guide/

Once again, thank you for all that you have done to create the Mahokenshi community and we hope you enjoy all of this sensational new content.

[b]Stay tuned for all the exciting news on Mahokenshi, and of course, join our community on Discord!
[/b]

notes.title: Mahokenshi — MAJOR Content Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Mahokenshi: The Designer's Guide 
[/h2]

Today, we are delighted to announce our biggest update [b]by far. [/b] Coming April 26th!

With these major additions, we wanted to give our community an immense thank you for all the support we have received since launch. We also wanted to show that we have been listening and sought to deliver on your biggest concerns- [b]more content, save-states, and replayability. [/b]

As a result, we’ve decided to implement three major changes: a brand new mission editor, the ability to save during missions, and a DLC pack with additional maps! 

[h3]The Mission Editor [/h3] 

This exciting and innovative tool will allow players to create their own maps, giving the community endless possibilities.

With the Mission Editor update you will gain access to the Custom Missions menu, where you can conveniently select to browse downloaded or create your own maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/c69fa670356f4ac18eff131f1a15d3f7918ca092.gif[/img]

The Mission Editor will conveniently allow the ability to browse downloaded maps or create your own, allowing you to shape your own maps, one hex at a time! This can mean placing hordes of enemies, setting objectives, creating quests with rewards, and more. It’s an expansive tool directly derived from what the developers used to create the campaign.

After you’re done creating a map and you’re satisfied, [b]you can simply upload it to the Steam workshop[/b], making it available for everyone! The community can then download it and try it out via the in-game menus. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/97348092d56b1ed8715ed087769bcb561ecbf895.gif[/img]

Rating maps will be conveniently done via the workshop as well, giving players a clear way to filter based on their preferences.

From here on it’s up to the community to choose your adventure. Read comments, create missions, dive into 5-star rated maps from others, or be a pioneer and try the newly uploaded maps.

[h3]Mid-Mission Saving Update[/h3]

One of the most requested features since launch has been the ability to save at any point during a mission, to allow for as much flexibility as possible while gaming. We saw and we have delivered! 

To ensure the most pleasant experience possible, this save feature will now be implemented in the game during any mission. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/541ae176b5ab71f8aa4791c25bda98e19707b713.gif[/img]

If you have to leave your computer you will be able to pick up your quest to save the Celestial Islands wherever you last left off. This should greatly ease flexibility with gameplay and make for a more enjoyable experience for all players!

[h3]The DLC pack: “Mahokenshi - The Designer's Guide”
[/h3]

This pack will include a handful of challenging maps functioning as a guide to show off the potential of the Mission Editor, helping creators to get started. 

These have been designed to help all players off the ground with learning the fundamentals of how to master our new editor. This should not only be both a great deal of fun, but an exciting challenge for all players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/bbb6d2a24a045113f4db5c38916480651cde25c6.png[/img]

Once again, thank you for all you have done to create the Mahokenshi community and we hope you enjoy all of this sensational new content.

[b]Stay tuned for all the exciting news on Mahokenshi, and of course, join our community on Discord!
[/b]

notes.title: Card Balancing
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Samurai, 
[/h3]

We wanted to give some more in-depth information about our most recent patch and the reasoning behind it. 

In this update we went through and changed the values of more than 25 different cards.  

To decide how to go at this to make for a more fair gaming experience, we investigated which cards had a low success rate among players, meaning cards that were not frequently present in game decks that resulted in a successful mission. 

We also analyzed strategies that seemed to be picked repeatedly or were more often successful and compare them to the strategies more infrequently used or those that commonly resulted in failures (As an example: poison did not seem to be commonly used or was often unsuccessful in combat, so we came to the decision to boost it).

With these changes, players should see more fair gameplay that can allow for mission success with a larger variety of gameplay strategies. 

For a list of the cards that were adjusted and other changes made, check out our patch note dedicated to the subject: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1717640/view/3663153926763307150

[h3]As always, thank you for your support and stay tuned for further updates!

Join our Discord community below⬇️:

notes.title: TurnbasedFest Is Here — Kaito Returns!
notes.notes:
Greetings Samurai,

[b]The turnbased fest is here![/b]

Who needs the stress of battling without taking your time and planning your turns in peace? The Turn-based fest is a celebration of these types of games, and Mahokenshi is no different.

Put yourself in the shoes of a Mahokenshi in our new Demo. Whether you want to wear the heavy armor of Kaito or sprout your wings like Ayaka, you are needed to save the celestial island of the forces of corruption.

Find out more about Kaito, our armored juggernaut, below!

[previewyoutube=gR41SByOtwM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Playstyle[/h2]
Unlike the other Mahokenshi, Kaito prefers being surrounded by his opponents. Although he has multiple deck archetypes and synergies, most of them revolve around stacking defense.

[h3]Spikes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/b94f9029c650fc46c6568fcf6b31c8b7abe59160.gif[/img]

The best offense is a good defense. Kaito can stack [b]Spikes[/b], icy thorns that hurt enemy attackers, even from afar!

[h3]Charge[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/63539f8a951f15c46d524f2fc996b1bd24bb4a52.png[/img]

Kaito does not dash like other Mahokenshi. Instead, his primary movement option is to [b]Charge[/b] towards his opponent. A Charge will allow Kaito to take the shortest possible path to his enemy, even dashing across water.

[h3]First Strike / Prepared[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/ee57ecc6d21bc7cc5bde5d10603854f3bdae3eeb.png[/img]

Some of Kaito's cards will have [b]First Strike[/b] and [b]Prepared[/b] effects. These cards will have different effects depending on when you play them within your turn, forcing you to think carefully about the order in which you play them.

[h3]Provoke[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/45654880466b72a5f5614edbe8542853cb5b8100.gif[/img]

Charging isn't the only way to get close to enemies. With his [b]Provoke[/b] cards, Kaito can force enemies to move into striking distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/11b255b037105089ebd3f53f920c8a0115630d04.png[/img]

Play the updated demo during TurnbasedFest, and make sure you check out the event page to play some more incredible demos!

notes.title: New Demo! Join The House of Jade 🕷
notes.notes:
Greetings, Samurai!

We're very excited to bring back our demo, this time with a brand new Mahokenshi to play. Take control of Sota from the House of Jade, who prefers to stick to the shadows and ambush his prey at the most opportune moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/569baf8952e2a107c2786de4bfe08d53292f5045.png[/img]

Also, this is our first demo available in English, French, Italian , German, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese and Polish! The translations are still in the beta stage, so if you spot any errors, please don't hesitate to let us know.

[h2]Available During Paris Games Week![/h2]

The demo is available [b]from now until November 6th[/b], while we're at Paris Games Week. Make sure you swing by the Jeux Made In France zone if you're also attending the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/5e7586f847c0a855c6db09552f6cbd569a6f55e8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/c6d5b9a6f48c76c3b22671305407a45eb32b6e93.jpg[/img]

[h2]Meet Sota[/h2]
Sota is a master of trickery and deception. With his varied movement cards, he can quickly cover the battlefield while also luring enemies off their positions of strength. Below are some of his main card mechanics.

[h3]Poison[/h3]
Sometimes blades aren't enough. Thankfully, Sota can employ the Ogumo's deadly [b]Poison[/b] to damage his enemies over time. If you didn't quite get the kill in the conventional way, your poison can finish the job for you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YJIOCwm.gif[/img]

[h3]Kunai[/h3]
Sota always has a trick up his sleeve, generally the sharp kind. His [b]Kunai[/b] are ephemeral cards (meaning they are removed from your deck when played) that deal a small amount of damage by themselves. Fill your hand with them, however, and you can unleash death by a thousand cuts on your opponent.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gzvJ81X.gif[/img]

[h3]Stealth[/h3]
As a master of terrain, Sota can take his time setting up for the perfect kill by using his [b]Stealth[/b] cards to ensure his enemies don't spot him before it's too late. Stealth cards are also great for dealing with groups of enemies, as only the target will aggro onto Sota.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NyFMWlI.gif[/img]

[h3]Lure[/h3]
Using the Ogumo's magic, Sota can place afterimages of himself on the battlefield. Lure cards have tons of potential uses. Use them to lure enemies away from their group, off beneficial terrain, or to cover your escape.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4xBpVHi.gif[/img]

So what are you waiting for? Take control of the master of deception and play the new Mahokenshi demo today! Let us know what you think of Sota on the forums, or join the community on Discord!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/QrkCYccVkZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/57663fbcb3888c8fa1305f962073ed8e07587395.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Mahokenshi Opens The Doors To Its Samurai Houses
notes.notes:
Dear Samurais!

Thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game and who joined us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/QrkCYccVkZ]Discord[/url]! We truly appreciate your support, and we were able to read all of your valuable feedback so far 😊 That being said, our upcoming update has a lot of improvements, and we want to call on you to be the first to road test our Early Access Preview.
Below is a summary of some of our upcoming improvements, to give you greater insight into what’s on the horizon.

[b]Have a look at our update trailer: [/b] 

[previewyoutube=UfB8h9cR0qc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[b]MAIN MENU [/b]
The new menu has been updated with all new visuals! We wanted to refine the display of just about everything, and as we're going to add new upcoming features, the space needed to be organized a little better.

[b]Before[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/6184b69a11c89360d243f309b8b95d6ebb20c817.png[/img]

[b]After[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/0a127b72bd7b1a7dbf87f4fcc05fe396ec643753.png[/img]


[b]MISSIONS’ HUB [/b]

The Missions Hub has been added to facilitate mission selection, as each one is progressively gated. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/f556fba567c4c5f147834d16d31d20f3b2ad6442.png[/img]

●	You will find the 3 main missions from the demo.	
●	The first mission is the tutorial to introduce you to the gameplay. It has been reworked to be more fluid, because the first version had a lot of explanations displayed on the screen during your fights.
●	The missions have a one-time currency reward: more information about how to use it with the realm tree below

On your adventures, you’ll notice a challenge button which leads to some greyed out elements: this just indicates we’re still working on this feature.

The Realm Tree button also leads to a largely greyed out screen, but with a bunch of upgrades for your Samurai. 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/1f8354339998cbb3af48822a860f68c0759570d6.png[/img]


REALM TREE 

Throughout your journey, you will also accumulate a currency which you will be able to spend in the Realm Expansion, to upgrade your Mahokenshi.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/f99e32f02866ccb2678e24bdbcc4d80f2a01f062.png[/img]

If you follow the path in each realm, you’ll be able to unlock unique features.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/96386400c04550d5b9746545cde7ef5d3cf2d900.png[/img]

This ranges from upgrading your cards to your Mahokenshi’s strength.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/a937417b1d401fe04406c432e7187f5480034967.png[/img]

For now, some parts of the Realm Tree aren’t interactive and are greyed out, as concept work is still being undertaken. 

[b]CHALLENGES (not implemented yet)[/b]
Each mission in Mahokenshi will have its own set of challenges to obtain more currencies and provide you with powerful upgrades. Over time, we’ll be adding far greater, deeper explanations, but for now it’s just an idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/4c51c1f0f38d4b02d6d9ff25afba42bfe393d0a1.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT [/b]

We’re redefining the enemies behavior, so that the Insurgents will flee when they are low life. If you don’t kill them, they are going to seek help from their friends and bring them to you!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/e0e7e7820c97378147ae565394617bb4276189b8.png[/img]

Oh, and Ayaka - the main playable character from House of Ruby has an all-new look!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/37beab7bd2b19766ff2a09ce109e1952751dc7d7.png[/img]

Look at her wings! 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/984336eb134ad24be80378dda85f8a6767c9da39.png[/img]

[b]WEATHERED ENVIRONMENTS[/b]
 
A common request from players has been weather effects, and we’re pleased to say that they’ve been added. We must stress that these aren’t dynamic and are fixed on a map. One of our ideas for the future is to eventually make the weather affect the gameplay, such as reducing movement or vision. 
VFX & SOUND

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/075d058b4701efa95e1bfdfbe910b3332c5282ac.png[/img]

We’re super pleased to say that there’s been a range of improvements across animations (notably combat) as well as sound for this build. We think it makes an enormous difference to the way combat plays and feels. While not quite finished, it’s a huge improvement on what we had previously. 

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]

You’ve asked for it, and our localization has begun. First on the list? French! Hourra! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047355/d261420c81c0f796fe15e27c6194f044c4876005.png[/img]

[b]WRAP UP[/b]
As we work towards our Early Access for winter, we’re keen to adopt a whole new direction for Mahokenshi, one that places you - our community - at its heart. Opening up the client, detailing our roadmap, showcasing what we’re working on and what we’re planning will be a regular feature of this new approach. We hope you join us for the adventure: there’s some exciting things around the corner. 

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/QrkCYccVkZ]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1717640/Mahokenshi/
